enums:
schema_version: oos/v1
enum: rev.ticket.kind
classes:
  posted: posted ticket
values:
  - code: P
    class: posted
    status: approved
    source: dictionary_table
    valid_from: "2020-01-01"
metric_yaml:
schema_version: oos/v1
metrics:
  - metric: closed_gross
    label: Closed gross
    owner: ledger
    status: active
    grain: [ticket]
    time_dimension: rev.ticket.booked_on
    default_anchor: month_start
    enum_filters:
      - column: rev.ticket.kind
        enum: rev.ticket.kind
        classes: [posted]
    sql: "SELECT gross FROM rev.ticket WHERE booked_on >= :period_start AND booked_on < :period_end AND kind = :kind"
    tests:
      - params: { period_start: "2026-03-01", period_end: "2026-04-01", kind: P }
        expect: { rows: 1 }
    control_total:
      as_of: last_closed_period_end
      source: tms_pg
      sql: "SELECT closed_sum FROM ops.hand_close WHERE anchor_day = :period_end"
      tolerance: { abs: "0" }
